definitions.gloss: unrelated, having no connection, nothing to do with
definitions.explanation: Having no relationship, connection, or involvement with something. Used to express that something is completely irrelevant to or separate from one's life or experience.

examples.japanese: {犯罪|はんざい}とは{無縁|むえん}の{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: I lead a life that has nothing to do with crime.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はギャンブルとは{無縁|むえん}の{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is someone who has nothing to do with gambling.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}に{住|す}んでいると、{自然|しぜん}とは{無縁|むえん}の{暮|く}らしになりがちだ。
examples.english: When you live in the city, you tend to lead a life disconnected from nature.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
Typically used in the pattern ～とは{無縁|むえん} (having nothing to do with ~) or as a の-adjective: {無縁|むえん}の{世界|せかい} (an unrelated world).

USAGE:
Combines {無|む} (without) and {縁|えん} (connection, ties). Also has a Buddhist meaning of having no karmic connection, and in modern social contexts, {無縁|むえん}{社会|しゃかい} (disconnected society) refers to the growing problem of social isolation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～とは{無縁|むえん}: having nothing to do with ~
- {無縁|むえん}{社会|しゃかい}: disconnected society
- {無縁|むえん}{仏|ぼとけ}: unclaimed dead (Buddhist term)
- {無縁|むえん}の{世界|せかい}: a world one has no connection to
